title: Izinkumbulo
description: Ten short stories about memories: a grandmother's childhood snow, a leopard at the kraal, a first fishing trip, an Easter remembered by a widow, pumpkin harvests, a prosecutor's memoir, a first bicycle and a broken arm, old wedding photos, a holiday diary from Cape Town, and a praise singer who inspired a schoolboy.

lessons.title: Iqhwa likagogo
lessons.summary: In Himeville, under a white winter sky, old Nomaswazi makes tea at the hearth and tells her grandson Sicebo about the snow of her childhood, when she wore her father's long jersey and her mother's big hat; he draws her story, and that night the snow falls again.
lessons.text:
UNomaswazi yisalukazi esihlala eHimeville, eduze nezintaba zeDrakensberg. Umzukulu wakhe, uSicebo, uneminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye. USicebo uhlala eThekwini nabazali bakhe, kodwa ngoJulayi uvakashela ugogo wakhe izinsuku eziyishumi.

USicebo uthanda kakhulu ukudweba. Njalo uphethe amaphepha, futhi uthanda ukudweba konke akubonayo: izintaba, izinkomo, izindlu nabantu. Ukudweba kumjabulisa kakhulu.

Ngolunye usuku ekuseni kubanda kakhulu. Isalukazi sibasa umlilo eziko. Sibeka amanzi phezu kweziko, senze itiye. USicebo nogogo wakhe bahlala eduze neziko, baphuza itiye elishisayo noshukela. Itiye libenza bafudumale.

USicebo uphuma ngaphandle, abheke isibhakabhaka. Isibhakabhaka asiluhlaza namuhla. Simhlophe, futhi siphansi. USicebo uyangena, abuze: "Gogo, kungani isibhakabhaka simhlophe namuhla?" Isalukazi sithi: "Uma isibhakabhaka sinjalo ebusika, iqhwa lingawa."

UNomaswazi uthela itiye futhi. Uthi: "Ake ngikutshele ngobusika engibukhumbulayo. Ngangiyingane eneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili. Lobo busika iqhwa lawa izinsuku ezintathu. Lamboza izindlu, izihlahla nemigwaqo. Ngaphambi kwalobo busika, angizange ngibone iqhwa.

"Ngagqoka ijezi elikhulu likababa wami nesigqoko sikamama wami. Ijezi lalilide kakhulu, lifika emadolweni ami. Isigqoko sasikhulu, simboza amehlo ami. Ngaphuma ngaphandle ngijabule, ngadlala eqhweni usuku lonke nengane yomakhelwane. Lobo busuku ngakhathala kakhulu, kodwa ngajabula.

"Ngosuku lwesine ilanga laphuma. Iqhwa laqala ukuncibilika. Amanzi agcwala yonke indawo. Ngakhala, ngoba iqhwa lami lincibilika. Umama wangenzela itiye eziko, wathi: 'Ungakhali. Iqhwa liyancibilika njalo, kodwa wena uzolikhumbula.' Futhi ngempela, ngiyalikhumbula nanamuhla."

Umzukulu uthatha iphepha lakhe. Uqala ukudweba intombazane encane egqoke ijezi elide nesigqoko esikhulu. Ngemuva kwalokho uqala ukudweba isibhakabhaka esiphansi neqhwa elimhlophe. Ugogo ubheka umdwebo, uyahleka. Uthi: "Yimi lena! Ukudweba kwakho kuhle kakhulu, mzukulu wami."

Ngalobo busuku iqhwa liyawa ngempela. Ekuseni yonke into imhlophe. USicebo ugqoka ijezi likagogo nesigqoko sakhe esidala, aphume ngaphandle. Udlala eqhweni ekuseni konke. Emini ilanga liyaphuma, iqhwa liyancibilika. Kodwa uSicebo akalili. Uthi: "Gogo, nami ngizolikhumbula leli qhwa, njengoba wena ukhumbula iqhwa lobo busika."

Imibuzo:
Kungani uSicebo ephethe amaphepha njalo?
Ngoba uthanda ukudweba konke akubonayo.
Isibhakabhaka sinjani ngalolo suku?
Simhlophe futhi siphansi, asiluhlaza.
UNomaswazi wagqokani lobo busika?
Wagqoka ijezi elikhulu likababa wakhe nesigqoko sikamama wakhe.
Kwenzekani ngosuku lwesine?
Ilanga laphuma, iqhwa laqala ukuncibilika.
Kungani uSicebo engakhali uma iqhwa lincibilika?
Ngoba uthi uzolikhumbula leli qhwa, njengoba ugogo wakhe ekhumbula iqhwa lobo busika.

lessons.title: Isilo saseBabanango
lessons.summary: Old Mfanukhona of Babanango tells his grandson Thalente why he checks the kraal fence every evening: as a boy he saw a leopard jump it, took it for a lion, and his father scared it off; he swears it is true, and that night a small dog jumping the fence gives Thalente a fright.
lessons.text:
UThalente uneminyaka eyisikhombisa. Uhlala nomkhulu wakhe, uMfanukhona, emaphandleni aseBabanango. Umkhulu unezinkomo eziyishumi. Ebusuku izinkomo zilala esibayeni eduze nendlu. Isibaya sinothango olude, olwenziwe ngezihlahla ezinameva.

Ngolunye usuku kusihlwa uThalente nomkhulu wakhe bavala isibaya. Umkhulu ubheka uthango lonke kahle. UThalente uyabuza: "Mkhulu, kungani ubheka uthango njalo kusihlwa?"

Umkhulu uhlala phansi phezu kwetshe. Uthi: "Ngoba ngikhumbula into eyenzeka ngesikhathi ngingumfana. Ngaleso sikhathi izilo eziningi zazizinga emagqumeni. Ebusuku zazizinga eduze nemizi, zifuna ukudla. Ngolunye ubusuku izinja zakhala kakhulu. Ngaphuma ngabheka isibaya. Ngabona into enkulu igxuma phezu kothango. Kwakuyisilwane esikhulu, esinomsila omude. Izinkomo zesaba, zagijima esibayeni. Ngacabanga ukuthi yingonyama. Ngabiza ubaba ngezwi elikhulu: 'Baba! Ingonyama isesibayeni!'

"Ubaba wami waphuma nomkhonto. Wabheka, wathi: 'Akuyona ingonyama. Izingonyama azisekho kula magquma. Yisilo.' Isilo sasibheka inkomo encane. Ubaba wenza umsindo omkhulu, washaya isitsha sensimbi ngenduku. Umsindo wasithusa isilo. Sagxuma futhi phezu kothango, sabaleka saya egqumeni. Ngabona umsila waso omude ebumnyameni.

"Ngakusasa mina nobaba senza uthango olusha, olude kakhulu. Kusukela ngalolo suku asizange sisibone futhi isilo eduze nesibaya." Umkhulu uthi: "Ngiyabheja, mzukulu wami, isilo sasisikhulu njengenja enkulu, futhi umsila waso wawumude njengengalo yami."

UThalente uyahleka. Uthi: "Mkhulu, awuqinisile!" Umkhulu uthi: "Ngiyabheja, Thalente. Ngasibona ngamehlo ami. Ngiyakhumbula nokuthi sangithusa kanjani."

UThalente ubheka amagquma. Ubuza: "Izilo zizinga emagqumeni namanje na?" Umkhulu uthi: "Zimbalwa manje. Ngonyaka odlule abantu babona isilo egqumeni eliseduze nomfula. Kodwa izingonyama azisekho lapha. Izingonyama zihlala ezindaweni zezilwane kuphela."

Ngalobo busuku uThalente akalali ngokushesha. Ulalele umsindo ngaphandle. Bese uzwa into igxuma phezu kothango lwesibaya. Iyamthusa kakhulu. Uvuka, abize umkhulu. Umkhulu uphuma nokukhanya. Eduze nothango kumi inja encane yomakhelwane. Umkhulu uyahleka. Uthi: "Bheka, Thalente! Le yingonyama yakho!" UThalente naye uyahleka, kodwa uthi: "Mkhulu, ngiyabheja, ngizwe into enkulu kunenja."

Imibuzo:
Kungani uMfanukhona ebheka uthango njalo kusihlwa?
Ngoba ukhumbula isilo esagxuma phezu kothango lwesibaya ngesikhathi engumfana.
UMfanukhona wacabangani lapho ebona isilo okokuqala?
Wacabanga ukuthi yingonyama.
Isilo sathuswa yini?
Sathuswa umsindo wesitsha sensimbi.
Kungani umkhulu ethi "Ngiyabheja"?
Ngoba uThalente uthi umkhulu wakhe akaqinisile.
Yini eyathusa uThalente ebusuku?
Yinja encane yomakhelwane eyagxuma phezu kothango.

lessons.title: Ukudoba nobaba
lessons.summary: Jabulisile remembers her first fishing day with her father Ndabezitha at a lake near Jozini: the muddy path and the frogs, the little boat, getting hungry, dropping her first fish, his warning not to swim there, and a muddy shortcut home.
lessons.text:
Ngiyakhumbula ubaba wami, uNdabezitha, ehamba echibini njalo ngoMgqibelo ekuseni. Sasihlala eJozini, eduze nechibi elikhulu. Ubaba wayengumlimi, kodwa into akuthanda kakhulu kunakho konke kwakungukudoba. Ngolunye uMgqibelo wathi kimi: "Jabulisile, namuhla uzohamba nami. Ngizokufundisa ukudoba." Ngangiyingane eneminyaka eyisithupha.

Sahamba ekuseni kakhulu. Indlela eya echibini yagcwala udaka, ngoba imvula yana izolo. Udaka lwalunuka kabi, futhi izicathulo zami zagcwala udaka. Eduze nechibi kwakukhona amasele amaningi. Amasele agxuma emanzini lapho esibona. Ngangesaba amasele, kodwa ubaba wahleka, wathi: "Isele alikwazi ukukulimaza."

Echibini kwakukhona isikebhe esincane sikababa. Sangena esikebheni, ubaba wasihambisa saya phakathi nechibi. Wathatha intambo yokudoba, wafaka ukudla ekugcineni kwayo, wayiphosa emanzini. Wangibonisa ukuthi ngingayiphosa kanjani intambo yami. Ngayiphosa emanzini. Ubaba wathi: "Manje kufanele silinde. Ukudoba kudinga isikhathi."

Salinda isikhathi eside. Ilanga laphuma, kwashisa. Ngaqala ukulamba. Ngathi: "Baba, ngilambile." Ubaba wangipha isinkwa namanzi. Wathi: "Umuntu oya ukudoba uvame ukulamba. Dla, bese sibuyela emsebenzini."

Ngemuva kwesikhathi intambo yami yadonsa kakhulu. Nami ngadonsa ngamandla. Inhlanzi enkulu yaphuma emanzini. Ngajabula kakhulu, kodwa lapho ngizama ukuyibeka esikebheni, ngayiwisa. Inhlanzi yawa emanzini, yabaleka. Ngakhala. Ubaba wathi: "Ungakhali. Nami ngaziwisa izinhlanzi eziningi ngesikhathi ngingumfana. Phosa futhi." Ngayiphosa intambo futhi. Ngemuva kwehora ngabamba inhlanzi encane. Kulokhu angizange ngiyiwise.

Ubaba wabheka abafana ababhukuda ngaphesheya kwechibi. Wathi: "Ungabhukudi kuleli chibi. Lijulile, futhi kukhona izingwenya." Kodwa ehlobo elalandela wangifundisa ukubhukuda emfuleni omncane ophephile.

Ekupheleni kosuku sabuyela ekhaya. Ubaba wathi: "Masinqamule ensimini, sizofika ngokushesha." Sanqamula ensimini yommbila, kodwa ensimini kwakukhona udaka oluningi. Ngawa odakeni! Ubaba wangiphakamisa, wahleka kakhulu. Ngathi: "Baba, ngeke siphinde sinqamule lapha!" Safika ekhaya sigcwele udaka. Umama wathi: "Niyanuka! Ninuka udaka nezinhlanzi!" Kodwa wazipheka izinhlanzi zethu, sazidla sonke. Ngalobo busuku ngalala ngijabule, futhi angizange ngilambe.

Imibuzo:
Kungani indlela eya echibini yagcwala udaka?
Ngoba imvula yana izolo.
UJabulisile wayesaba yini eduze nechibi?
Wayesaba amasele.
Kwenzekani enhlanzini yokuqala?
UJabulisile wayiwisa, yawa emanzini, yabaleka.
Kungani ubaba ethi uJabulisile angabhukudi echibini?
Ngoba ichibi lijulile, futhi kukhona izingwenya.
Kungani umama ethi bayanuka?
Ngoba bafika ekhaya begcwele udaka, futhi banuka izinhlanzi.

lessons.title: IPhasika eMtunzini
lessons.summary: Widow Ntombenkosi of Mtunzini helps the church women decorate for Easter and remembers how they came for her after her husband died; at the district service, dressed in white, she hears a young man play her late husband's trumpet.
lessons.text:
UNtombenkosi ungumfelokazi waseMtunzini. Umyeni wakhe, uBhekinkosi, wafa eminyakeni eyisithupha edlule. Njalo ngePhasika uNtombenkosi uyamkhumbula kakhulu, ngoba uBhekinkosi wadlala icilongo esontweni iminyaka engamashumi amathathu. NgeSonto lePhasika wadlala icilongo lakhe ngaphambi kwazo zonke izingoma.

Ngesonto elingaphambi kwePhasika abesimame besonto bayahlangana. Bahlobisa isonto ngezimbali ezimhlophe nezingubo ezinhle. UNtombenkosi uyabasiza ukuhlobisa. Ngesikhathi ehlobisa, ukhumbula iPhasika lokuqala ngemuva kokufa komyeni wakhe. Ngalolo suku wakhala kakhulu. Akazange afune ukuya esontweni, noma ukubona abantu.

Kodwa ngalolo suku abesimame besonto beza endlini yakhe. Bathi: "Mama, ungumfelokazi manje, kodwa awuhlali wedwa. Thina sikhona." Bamsiza ukwembatha izingubo zakhe zesonto, bahamba naye esontweni. Kusukela ngalolo suku abesimame besonto bangabangane bakhe abakhulu. Phakathi kwabo kukhona abafelokazi abaningi, futhi bayasizana.

Ekuseni ngeSonto lePhasika uNtombenkosi uvuka ekuseni kakhulu. Wembatha ingubo yakhe emhlophe nesigqoko esimhlophe. Abesimame besonto lakhe bembatha okumhlophe njalo ngePhasika. Kulo nyaka amasonto onke ehlelo laseMtunzini ahlangana esontweni elikhulu. Abantu bavela ezindaweni zonke zehlelo. Isonto ligcwele.

Umfundisi omkhulu wehlelo uqala ukuthandaza. Bonke bathandaza ndawonye: "Baba wethu osezulwini, malingcweliswe igama lakho." UNtombenkosi ukhumbula ukuthi uBhekinkosi wawathanda lawa mazwi. Umfundisi uthi: "Namuhla siyambonga uSomandla ngePhasika. Masilingcwelise igama likaSomandla ngezingoma zethu."

Bese insizwa iyasukuma. Iphethe icilongo. UNtombenkosi uyalazi lelo cilongo: yicilongo likamyeni wakhe. Ngemuva kokufa kukaBhekinkosi walinika isonto. Manje le nsizwa iyalidlala. Umsindo wecilongo ugcwalisa isonto. UNtombenkosi uyakhala, kodwa futhi uyajabula.

Ngemuva kokuthandaza insizwa iza kuye. Ithi: "Mama, ngiyabonga ngecilongo. Ngizolinakekela kahle." UNtombenkosi uthi: "Dlala kahle, ndodana. Umyeni wami wadlala lelo cilongo ngePhasika iminyaka eminingi." Abesimame besonto bayamamukela, bathi: "Siyajabula ngoba icilongo likaBhekinkosi liyadlalwa futhi."

Kusihlwa uNtombenkosi uhlala yedwa endlini yakhe. Ubheka isithombe somyeni wakhe. Bese uyathandaza: "Ngiyabonga, Somandla, ngePhasika lalo nyaka. Ngiyabonga ngabesimame besonto. Malingcweliswe igama lakho."

Imibuzo:
Kungani uNtombenkosi ekhumbula umyeni wakhe ngePhasika?
Ngoba uBhekinkosi wadlala icilongo esontweni ngePhasika iminyaka eminingi.
Abesimame besonto bahlobisa isonto ngani?
Balihlobisa ngezimbali ezimhlophe nezingubo ezinhle.
Kwenzekani ngePhasika lokuqala ngemuva kokufa kukaBhekinkosi?
UNtombenkosi wakhala, kodwa abesimame besonto beza kuye, bamsiza ukwembatha izingubo zesonto.
Abesimame bembathani ngePhasika?
Bembatha okumhlophe.
Ubani odlala icilongo likaBhekinkosi manje?
Yinsizwa yesonto.

lessons.title: Amathanga asePongola
lessons.summary: Mpilonhle sees pumpkins in a Johannesburg shop and remembers the harvests in Pongola, when there were too many pumpkins, some rotted, and she and her mother Ncamisile took them to the neighbours; she cooks pumpkin with maize meal as her mother did and phones her.
lessons.text:
UMpilonhle uhlala eGoli, futhi usebenza ehhovisi edolobheni. Ngolunye usuku uya esitolo ukuthenga ukudla. Esitolo ubona amathanga amakhulu. Ithanga ngalinye libiza imali eningi. UMpilonhle uma, abheke amathanga. Ukhumbula ikhaya lakhe ePongola, nomama wakhe, uNcamisile.

Ngesikhathi uMpilonhle eyingane, umama wakhe walima amathanga ensimini enkulu. Ngesikhathi somvuno kwakukhona ubuningi bamathanga. Amathanga agcwala insimu yonke. UMpilonhle nomama wakhe bawaqoqa, bawabeka ngaphansi kwesihlahla eduze nendlu. Ingaphandle lethanga ngalinye laliluhlaza, futhi liqinile. Kodwa ngaphakathi ithanga linombala omuhle, futhi lithambile.

Ubuningi bamathanga baba yinkinga. Umndeni wawungeke uwadle wonke. Amanye amathanga aqala ukubola. Ithanga elibolile linuka kabi. UNcamisile wathi: "Asifuni ukuthi amathanga ethu abole. Masiwalethele omakhelwane." Ngakho uMpilonhle nomama wakhe bathatha amathanga, bawalethela omakhelwane, ogogo abadala nabafundisi besikole. Umakhelwane omdala wathi: "Ngiyabonga, ngane yami. Uzongilethela futhi ngomvuno ozayo na?"

Ngalobo busuku uNcamisile wapheka ekhishini. Ikhishi lalincane, kodwa lihlanzekile. Wapheka ukudla okwenziwa ngethanga nempuphu, okubizwa ngokuthi isijingi. Wasika ithanga, walipheka ngamanzi. Ngemuva kwalokho wafaka impuphu kancane kancane, nosawoti omncane noshukela. UMpilonhle wahlala ekhishini, wabuka umama wakhe. Umama wathi: "Ungafaki usawoti omningi. Uma kunosawoti omningi, ukudla akumnandi."

Uma ukudla kuvuthiwe, umama wacima umlilo. Wathi: "Cima umlilo njalo uma uqeda ukupheka. Umlilo ekhishini uyingozi." Bese badla ndawonye ekhishini. Ukudla kwakumnandi kakhulu.

Manje uMpilonhle uthenga ithanga elilodwa. Ekhaya, ekhishini lakhe, uyalisika. Ingaphandle lethanga liluhlaza futhi liqinile, njengamathanga asePongola. Upheka ithanga ngempuphu, nosawoti omncane, njengomama wakhe. Uma ukudla kuvuthiwe, ucima umlilo. Ukhumbula amazwi kamama wakhe.

Ngemuva kokudla ushayela umama wakhe. Uthi: "Mama, namuhla ngiphekile ithanga nempuphu, njengawe!" UNcamisile uyahleka. Uthi: "Kuhle, ngane yami. Umvuno walo nyaka muhle kakhulu. Kukhona ubuningi bamathanga futhi. Ngizokulethela amathanga amaningi uma ngiza eGoli." UMpilonhle uyajabula. Uthi: "Ngicela ungilethele namanye, ukuze ngiwalethele abangane bami."

Imibuzo:
UMpilonhle ubonani esitolo?
Ubona amathanga amakhulu.
Ingaphandle lethanga linjani?
Liluhlaza futhi liqinile.
Kungani ubuningi bamathanga baba yinkinga?
Ngoba umndeni wawungeke uwadle wonke, futhi amanye aqala ukubola.
UNcamisile wenzani ngamathanga amaningi?
Wawalethela omakhelwane, ogogo abadala nabafundisi besikole.
Umama wathini ngomlilo ekhishini?
Wathi kufanele ucime umlilo njalo uma uqeda ukupheka, ngoba umlilo ekhishini uyingozi.

lessons.title: Incwadi yomshushisi
lessons.summary: Retired Pretoria prosecutor Sizwesihle becomes a writer and remembers his career: the teacher who encouraged him, a young thief who stole for cannabis and later changed, and a murder trial on television that kept him awake; his wife sees him on TV with his book.
lessons.text:
USizwesihle wasebenza njengomshushisi ePitoli iminyaka engamashumi amathathu. Umshushisi ukhuluma ngaphambi kwejaji, futhi ubonisa ukuthi umuntu wenze icala. Manje uSizwesihle akasebenzi, futhi unesikhathi esiningi ekhaya. Ngolunye usuku uthi kumfazi wakhe: "Ngifuna ukuba ngumlobi. Ngizobhala incwadi ngezinto engazibona emsebenzini wami."

Njalo ekuseni uSizwesihle uhlala etafuleni, abhale. Okokuqala ubhala ngokuthi waba kanjani ngumshushisi. Ngesikhathi efunda esikoleni, umfundisi wakhe wabona ukuthi uyakwazi ukukhuluma kahle. Umfundisi wamshushisa, wathi: "Uzoba ngumshushisi omuhle. Funda umthetho." Lawo mazwi amshushisa kakhulu. Wafunda umthetho iminyaka emine.

Bese umlobi omusha ubhala ngecala lakhe lokuqala. Insizwa encane yantshontsha imali esitolo. Yathatha leyo mali, yathenga insangu. Amaphoyisa ayibamba ibhema insangu ngaphandle kwesitolo. USizwesihle wakhuluma nayo. Wathi: "Kungani wantshontsha? Insangu ayikusizi." Insizwa yathi: "Ngiyaxolisa. Ngantshontsha ngoba ngangidinga insangu." Ijaji layithumela ejele izinyanga eziyisithupha, futhi layalela insizwa ukuthi iyeke insangu. Ngemuva kweminyaka eyishumi le nsizwa yabhalela uSizwesihle incwadi: "Manje angiyibhemi insangu, futhi angintshontshi. Ngiyasebenza." USizwesihle wajabula kakhulu.

Kodwa icala elinzima kunawo wonke kwakuyicala lombulali. Lo mbulali wabulala indoda esitolo sayo, wantshontsha imali yayo. Abantu abaningi babuka icala kumabonakude. Ngobusuku obungaphambi kosuku lokugcina lwecala, uSizwesihle waqwasha. Waqwasha ubusuku bonke, ecabanga ngomndeni wendoda efile.

Ngosuku lokugcina ijaji layalela amaphoyisa ukuthi alethe bonke abantu ababona umbulali. Layalela nombulali ukuthi athule ngesikhathi bekhuluma. Ekugcineni isiphetho secala safika. Ijaji lathi: "Lo muntu ungumbulali." Ijaji lamthumela ejele iminyaka eminingi. Kusihlwa uSizwesihle wabona isiphetho secala kumabonakude. Ngalobo busuku akazange aqwashe. Walala kahle.

Manje uSizwesihle uqeda incwadi yakhe. Ubhala isiphetho sencwadi: "Umsebenzi womshushisi unzima. Imbala, ngaqwasha ubusuku obuningi. Kodwa ngiyajabula, ngoba ngasiza abantu abaningi." Umfazi wakhe ufunda isiphetho, uthi: "Lena yimbala. Wasebenza kanzima."

Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu incwadi iyaphuma. Abantu abaningi bayayithenga. USizwesihle ukhuluma kumabonakude ngencwadi yakhe. Umfazi wakhe uyambuka kumabonakude, uyahleka. Uthi: "Imbala, manje ungumlobi!"

Imibuzo:
Kungani uSizwesihle efuna ukuba ngumlobi?
Ngoba unesikhathi esiningi ekhaya, futhi ufuna ukubhala ngezinto azibona emsebenzini wakhe.
Ubani owashushisa uSizwesihle ukuthi afunde umthetho?
Umfundisi wakhe wesikole wamshushisa.
Kungani insizwa yokuqala yantshontsha imali?
Yantshontsha imali ngoba yayidinga insangu.
Kungani uSizwesihle waqwasha ngaphambi kosuku lokugcina lwecala lombulali?
Ngoba wacabanga ngomndeni wendoda efile.
Abantu babona kuphi uSizwesihle ekhuluma ngencwadi yakhe?
Bambona kumabonakude.

lessons.title: Ibhayisikili elibomvu
lessons.summary: Mhlonishwa remembers his first bicycle in Hammarsdale: playing outside all day, the leaking tyre he would not change, the bang when it burst on the hill, a broken arm, the injection he feared, and his mother making his bed while the arm healed.
lessons.text:
Ngiyakhumbula ibhayisikili lami lokuqala. Ngangingumfana oneminyaka eyishumi, futhi sasihlala eHammarsdale. Ngolunye usuku ubaba wangithengela ibhayisikili elibomvu. Lalidala, kodwa ngalithanda kakhulu.

Kusukela ngalolo suku ngangihlala phandle. Ngagibela ibhayisikili lami phandle usuku lonke, nabangane bami. Umama wathi: "Mhlonishwa, ngena endlini! Uhlala phandle njalo!" Kodwa angizange ngingene. Phandle kwakumnandi kakhulu kunasendlini.

Kodwa kwakukhona inkinga eyodwa: isondo elingemuva lalivuza. Njalo ekuseni ngangifaka umoya esondweni. Ubaba wathi: "Isondo liyavuza. Kufanele silishintshe." Kodwa ngathi: "Cha, baba, lisebenza kahle. Livuza kancane nje." Ngaqhubeka ngigibela ibhayisikili, nesondo elivuzayo.

Sasihlala ngapha komfula. Isibhedlela nesitolo esikhulu kwakukhona ngaphesheya komfula. Ngapha komfula kwakukhona umgwaqo omude owehla egqumeni. Abafana abaningi bagibela amabhayisikili kulowo mgwaqo.

Ngolunye uMgqibelo ngehla kulowo mgwaqo ngokushesha okukhulu. Bese ngezwa umsindo omkhulu: ukuqhuma! Isondo elivuzayo laqhuma. Ukuqhuma kwesondo kwathusa abantu abaningi emgwaqweni. Ngawa phansi. Isondo lephuka, nami ngayaphula ingalo yami. Ingalo yami yayibuhlungu kakhulu.

Ubaba wangifaka emotweni, sahamba ngaphesheya komfula, saya esibhedlela. Udokotela wabheka ingalo yami. Wathi: "Uyaphule ingalo yakho." Ngaphambi kokuyilungisa, wathi uzonginika umjovo. Ngangesaba umjovo kakhulu. Ngakhala. Udokotela wathi: "Umjovo uzokusiza. Ngemuva komjovo ngeke uzwe ubuhlungu." Ngempela, ngemuva komjovo angizange ngizwe ubuhlungu.

Kusihlwa sabuyela ekhaya ngapha komfula. Umama wendlala umbhede wami kahle, wangibeka kuwo. Wathi: "Namuhla ngeke uhlale phandle." Ngahlala embhedeni izinsuku ezimbili. Njalo ekuseni umama wendlala umbhede wami futhi, ngoba ukuwendlala ngesandla esisodwa kwakunzima kimi.

Ingalo yami yaphola ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbili. Ubaba walungisa ibhayisikili. Wafaka isondo elisha, elingavuzi, esikhundleni sesondo elephukile. Wathi: "Manje ungahamba futhi. Kodwa hamba kancane egqumeni." Ngamlalela.

Manje nginendodana encane. Angikhohlwa ukuqhuma kwalelo sondo. Ngakho uma indodana yami ifuna ukugibela ibhayisikili phandle, ngithi kuyo: "Bheka amasondo kuqala. Uma isondo livuza, silungise ndawonye. Futhi hamba kancane egqumeni!"

Imibuzo:
Kungani uMhlonishwa wahlala phandle njalo?
Ngoba wagibela ibhayisikili lakhe phandle usuku lonke.
Iyiphi inkinga yebhayisikili?
Isondo elingemuva lalivuza.
Kwenzekani ngesikhathi uMhlonishwa ehla egqumeni?
Isondo laqhuma, lephuka, wawa phansi, wayaphula ingalo yakhe.
Kungani uMhlonishwa akhala esibhedlela?
Ngoba wayesaba umjovo.
Kungani umama wendlala umbhede wakhe njalo ekuseni?
Ngoba ukuwendlala ngesandla esisodwa kwakunzima kuye.

lessons.title: Izithombe zomshado
lessons.summary: On their fiftieth wedding anniversary in Durban, Nkosingiphile and Nomfundo look at the photos she has kept: the groom in brown, their first baby, the years apart when he worked in Johannesburg; he forgets a friend's name, and their grandchild asks for a photo.
lessons.text:
UNkosingiphile noNomfundo bahlala eThekwini. Bashada eminyakeni engamashumi amahlanu edlule. Namuhla wusuku lwabo lomshado. Umzukulu wabo uzofika kusihlwa, ukuze adle nabo.

Ekuseni uNomfundo ukhipha ibhokisi elidala. Kuleli bhokisi ulonde izithombe zabo zakudala iminyaka eminingi. Uthi: "Ngizilonde kahle lezi zithombe, ngoba ziyasikhumbuza izinsuku zethu zakudala." Bahlala ndawonye etafuleni, babheke izithombe.

Isithombe sokuqala yisithombe somshado wabo. UNkosingiphile wayengumkhwenyana omusha. Wembatha izingubo ezinsundu nesigqoko esinsundu. UNomfundo wembatha ingubo emhlophe. UNkosingiphile uyahleka: "Bheka lo mkhwenyana! Lezo zingubo ezinsundu zazibiza imali eningi." UNomfundo uthi: "Wawungumkhwenyana omuhle. Futhi namanje uyisithandwa sami."

Isithombe sesibili sibonisa usana lwabo lokuqala, indodakazi yabo. Usana lugqoke ijezi elincane elinsundu. UNomfundo uthi: "Ngiyalikhumbula lelo jezi. Ngalenza ngezandla zami. Usana lwethu lwalukhala ubusuku bonke, futhi ngangiqwasha njalo."

Isithombe sesithathu sibonisa uNkosingiphile emi eduze nesitimela. Lesi sithombe sibakhumbuza ukwehlukana kwabo. UNkosingiphile waya eGoli ukuthola umsebenzi, wasebenza khona iminyaka emithathu. UNomfundo wahlala nosana eThekwini. Ukwehlukana kwakunzima kubo bobabili. Babhalelana izincwadi njalo ngesonto. Izincwadi zikaNomfundo zaqala njalo ngamazwi athi: "Isithandwa sami."

UNkosingiphile uthi: "Ngiyakhumbula ukuthi ngaphupha ngawe njalo ebusuku. Ngaphupha ukuthi ngibuyela ekhaya, nginike usana ijezi elisha." UNomfundo uthi: "Nami ngaphupha ngawe. Ukwehlukana kwasenza saqina."

Manje bobabili bagugile. UNkosingiphile uthi: "Siguge kakhulu. Bheka izinwele zami ezimhlophe." UNomfundo uthi: "Siyaguga, kodwa uthando lwethu alugugi. Kambe, uyakhumbula ukuthi umshado wethu waqala ngehora lesithathu?" UNkosingiphile uthi: "Yebo, ngiyakhumbula."

UNkosingiphile ubheka isithombe sabantu ngosuku lomshado. Ukhomba indoda eyodwa. Uthi: "Lo muntu ngubani? Igama lakhe lingilibele." UNomfundo uyahleka. Uthi: "NguMvuselelo, umngane wakho omkhulu! Amagama amaningi ayakulibala manje." UNkosingiphile naye uyahleka: "Kunjalo. Kodwa igama lesithandwa sami alingilibali."

UNomfundo uthi: "Kambe, umzukulu wethu ufika ngehora lesithupha. Masilungise ukudla." Kusihlwa umzukulu uyafika. Babonisa izithombe. Umzukulu uthi: "Kambe, gogo, ngicela ungiphe lesi sithombe somkhwenyana nesithandwa sakhe. Ngizosilonda kahle." UNomfundo uthi: "Sithathe, mzukulu wami. Kodwa ungalibali ukusibuyisa!"

Imibuzo:
UNomfundo ulonde yini ebhokisini elidala?
Ulonde izithombe zabo zakudala.
UNkosingiphile wembathani ngosuku lomshado?
Wembatha izingubo ezinsundu nesigqoko esinsundu.
Kungani uNomfundo waqwasha njalo?
Ngoba usana lwabo lwalukhala ubusuku bonke.
Ukwehlukana kwabo kwenzeka kanjani?
UNkosingiphile waya eGoli ukuthola umsebenzi iminyaka emithathu, uNomfundo wahlala nosana eThekwini.
Igama likabani elimlibele uNkosingiphile?
Igama likaMvuselelo, umngane wakhe omkhulu.

lessons.title: Iholide eKapa
lessons.summary: Sbahle reads the diary of a childhood holiday in Cape Town won in a petrol company's competition: nearly missing the trip, free petrol, a hotel in the city centre, sunburn that peeled, and a beach clean-up; then she sees the same company advertising on TV.
lessons.text:
USbahle uneminyaka engamashumi amathathu manje. Ngolunye usuku uthola incwadi yakhe yakudala ebhokisini. Ngesikhathi eyintombazane, wabhala kuyo ngeholide lomndeni wakhe eKapa. Uyayivula, uyafunda.

"NgoMsombuluko. Namuhla ubaba usitshele indaba enkulu. Inkampane kaphethiloli ikhangisa umncintiswano. Ubaba ungene emncintiswaneni, futhi uphumelele! Umklomelo yiholide eKapa izinsuku eziyisikhombisa. Inkampane ingumxhasi weholide lonke. Umxhasi uzosinika ihhotela, nophethiloli wemoto yethu."

"NgoLwesithathu. Siqale uhambo ngemoto namuhla ekuseni. Cishe ngaphuthelwa uhambo, ngoba ngangilala. Ubaba wathi: 'Sbahle, vuka manje, noma uzophuthelwa iholide lonke!' Ngavuka ngokushesha. Endleleni sima kaningi ukuthenga uphethiloli. Ubaba akakhokhi imali, ngoba inkampane kaphethiloli ingumxhasi wethu. Uphethiloli awusibizi imali."

"NgoLwesine. Sifikile eKapa. Ihhotela lethu lisenkabeni yedolobha. Enkabeni yedolobha kunabantu abaningi, izitolo nezimoto eziningi. Ubaba uthi: 'Bheka laphaya!' Laphaya kukhona intaba enkulu, iphezulu njengetafula. Umama uthi: 'Abantu abaningi bayayikhuphuka leyo ntaba.' Ngiyafuna ukuya laphaya."

"NgoLwesihlanu. Namuhla sihambe olwandle. Ngadlala esihlabathini usuku lonke elangeni. Angizange ngigqoke isigqoko. Kusihlwa amahlombe ami abomvu, futhi abuhlungu kakhulu. Umama uthi: 'Isikhumba sakho sizokwebuka.'"

"NgoMgqibelo. Namuhla olwandle kukhona udoti omningi. Abantu bashiye udoti esihlabathini: amabhodlela namaphepha. Inkampane ikhangisa usuku lokuhlanza ulwandle, futhi ingumxhasi walo. Siqoqe udoti amahora amabili nabanye abantu, safaka udoti ezikhwameni. Ekugcineni ulwandle luhlanzekile."

"NgeSonto. Isikhumba samahlombe ami siyebuka! Siyebuka njengesikhumba senyoka. Ngiyasidonsa kancane. Umama uthi: 'Ungasidonsi. Siyebuka ngokwaso.' Kodwa sihambe enkabeni yedolobha, sakhuphuka laphaya, phezu kwentaba. Phezulu kwakubanda, kodwa kwakumnandi."

"NgoMsombuluko. Sibuyela ekhaya. Iholide lihle kakhulu. Ngiyabonga, nkampane kaphethiloli!"

USbahle uvala incwadi, uyahleka. Ukhumbula isikhumba esiyebukayo namahlombe abuhlungu. Ngalobo busuku ubona inkampane efanayo ikhangisa kumabonakude. Ikhangisa umncintiswano omusha weholide. USbahle uthi kumyeni wakhe: "Ngizongena. Angifuni ukuphuthelwa yiholide lezingane zethu."

Imibuzo:
Umxhasi weholide wayengubani?
Inkampane kaphethiloli yayingumxhasi weholide.
Kungani uSbahle cishe waphuthelwa uhambo?
Ngoba walala isikhathi eside, akavukanga ngesikhathi.
Ihhotela lalikuphi eKapa?
Lalisenkabeni yedolobha.
Kungani isikhumba sikaSbahle sebuka?
Ngoba wadlala elangeni usuku lonke engagqokile isigqoko.
Bawenzani udoti olwandle?
Baqoqa udoti amahora amabili, bawufaka ezikhwameni.

lessons.title: Imbongi esikoleni
lessons.summary: Teacher Thulasizwe of Ulundi remembers the day an old, bow-legged praise singer visited his school and told the children to fill their lungs; inspired, he praised in the culture show and became the school champion, and now he invites a praise singer every year.
lessons.text:
UThulasizwe ungumfundisi wesikole oLundi. Kodwa uyakhumbula kahle usuku olwashintsha impilo yakhe. Ngaleso sikhathi wayengumfana omncane, futhi wafunda ebangeni lesithupha esikoleni esincane oLundi.

Ngolunye usuku umfundisi wabo, uNolubabalo, wathi: "Namuhla sinomuntu okhethekile: imbongi." Imbongi yayiyindoda endala, uMfanzile. Yayiyisigwegwe: imilenze yayo igobile. Abanye abafana bahleka kancane, ngoba babona isigwegwe esihamba kancane. Kodwa lapho imbongi iqala ukubonga, izwi layo laligcwalisa isikole sonke. Abafana abahleka bathula ngokushesha. Izwi elikhulu lesigwegwe labashaqa bonke.

Imbongi yabonga amakhosi akudala amaZulu, izintaba nemifula yezwe lethu. Ngemuva kwalokho yathi kubafundi: "Imbongi idinga amaphaphu aqinile. Phefumula kakhulu, ugcwalise amaphaphu akho ngomoya, bese ukhuluma ngezwi elikhulu." Bonke abafundi baphefumula kakhulu, bagcwalisa amaphaphu abo. Imbongi yathi: "Ukubonga kuyingxenye yemvelaphi yethu. Ningakhohlwa imvelaphi yenu." Amazwi ayo aba wugqozi kuThulasizwe. Wathola ugqozi olukhulu kulolo suku.

Ngenyanga elandelayo isikole saba nomdlalo wemvelaphi. Umdlalo waba nezigcawu ezintathu. Esigcawini sokuqala abafundi bacula izingoma zakudala. Esigcawini sesibili abafana namantombazane basina. Esigcawini sesithathu kwakukhona umncintiswano wezimbongi. Abafana abahlanu bangena emncintiswaneni. Lowo ophumelelayo uzoba ngumpetha wesikole.

UThulasizwe wagqoka izingubo zesintu. Waphatha induku kagogo wakhe. Ngokuphakamisa induku yakhe, waqala ukubonga. Ukuphakamisa induku kwakusho ukuthi bonke abantu kufanele bathule. Wagcwalisa amaphaphu akhe ngomoya, wabonga isikole, amagquma aseLundi nogogo wakhe. Izwi lakhe laba likhulu kakhulu. Izwi lakhe labashaqa abazali nabafundi. Kwamshaqa nomfundisi wakhe, uNolubabalo. Ugogo wakhe wakhala ngoba ejabule.

Ekugcineni uNolubabalo wathi: "Umpetha wesikole kulo nyaka nguThulasizwe!" Abantu bashaya izandla. UThulasizwe wajabula kakhulu. Ngemuva kwesigcawu sokugcina uMfanzile weza kuye. Imbongi endala yamthinta ehlombe, yathi: "Mfana wami, ungumpetha namuhla, kodwa futhi uyimbongi yangempela. Qhubeka. Ungakhohlwa imvelaphi yakho."

Manje uThulasizwe ungumfundisi. Njalo ngonyaka umema imbongi esikoleni sakhe. Uthi kubafundi bakhe: "Ugqozi lwami lwaqala ngosuku imbongi eyafika ngalo esikoleni sami. Gcwalisani amaphaphu enu, nibonge ngezwi elikhulu!"

Imibuzo:
UMfanzile wayengubani?
Wayeyimbongi endala, futhi wayeyisigwegwe.
Imbongi yathi idinga yini?
Yathi idinga amaphaphu aqinile.
Kwenzekani esigcawini sesithathu somdlalo?
Kwakukhona umncintiswano wezimbongi.
UThulasizwe waqala kanjani ukubonga?
Waqala ngokuphakamisa induku kagogo wakhe.
Ubani owaba ngumpetha wesikole?
UThulasizwe waba ngumpetha wesikole.
